dhinakat.en: dhinakat, the sound of the mṛdaṅga drum

thai.en: thai, a syllable of the dance and drum beat

dhik.en: dhik, a syllable of the dance beat (tāṃ dhik tāṃ)

girijā.hi: गिरिजा, पर्वतराज हिमालयकी पुत्री पार्वतीजी, शिवजीकी पत्नी
girijā.en: Girijā, Pārvatī, daughter of the mountain king, Śiva's wife
